target_profile.scope: Native Apple-silicon macOS binaries, including required public and Apple-specific extensions and ABI behavior; host extensions selected by explicit capability checks.
target_profile.inventory_limits: Reviewed shared A64 forms only. This list is not a complete Apple CPU feature contract, private-extension inventory, or binary-compatibility denominator.

instruction_sources.redistribution_scope: Only factual identifiers, names, categorical/feature metadata and fixed encoding bits are included. Arm XML, authored instruction prose and pseudocode remain local and are not redistributed.

profile.description: Implemented means complete reviewed encoding-form semantics in the current bounded ARM64 leaf/direct private ordinary-RAM profile, not complete platform execution. Partial means defined operands, control flow, or required semantics remain restricted. Aliases have no separate entries.
outside_scope: full guest exception delivery and asynchronous state reconstruction
concurrent atomic and complete ARM memory-ordering semantics
full application ABI and macOS boot

status_policy: Statuses apply only to explicitly reviewed forms in the declared bounded profile. Unreviewed required Apple forms have unknown count and are not claimed supported. Neither reviewed-form ratios nor corpus frequency represent whole-binary or OS completion. Aliases are not separate support units.
